rule: r3 B1: the 5.0.x members of a dimension are the 5.0.x blocks the GT has (this file); an expected block a report lacks is scored 0 with the expected n, a block the GT does not have is not a member even when a report has it (model-only content, e.g. extra cuts or invented objects), the activation clause counts the expected n of the 5.0.x members, and a slot condition 'unless_509_na' / 'when_509_na' reads the expected dims

A1.counts.rule: one row per (space, class) of unnamed GT objects

A3.floor_dz.rule: as space_size, one row per non-sloped space after the first

A3.space_size.rule: >= 2 spaces, shared frames, a model footprint for every space

B1.pair_dist.rule: track pairs with a common known time (0 when one is missing)

B1.progress.rule: tracks of > 0.5 m in one known span (needs the model timeline)

B1.space_order.rule: tracks through >= 2 spaces (needs the model timeline)

B1.stops_turns.rule: moving tracks with a GT stop (needs the model timeline)

B2.occurrence.rule: one row per GT event and space transition

B2.order.rule: pairs of supported events with distinct times

B2.posture.rule: tracks with a posture label other than stand (0 without a timeline)

B2.timing.rule: one row per event of a supported type (0 when unmatched)

C1.fov.rule: shots with a GT field of view (needs the model shot)

C1.height.rule: shots with a GT camera height (needs the model shot)

C1.subject.rule: shots with a placed GT camera and a known subject position

C2.cuts.rule: one row per GT cut (model extra cuts are not expected rows)

C2.durations.rule: one row per cut-separated GT shot group (>= 2 shots)

C2.transitions.rule: one row per GT shot boundary

D1.class_size.rule: instances or bodies of a registered class

D1.float_sink.rule: non-mounted objects in non-sloped spaces, or agents / animals

D1.penetration.rule: instances: unnamed GT objects or static named entities

D1.scale.rule: spaces whose alignment is ok (>= min_anchors inliers for a perfect answer)
